case.rest: Okusele kuza lapho isikhathi sikudinga, futhi ngakunye kusho ukuthi kanjani.
case.offText: Kuvaliwe: umsizi {name} akakunikezi, futhi akukho okwakho okubonakalayo noma okulayishwayo.
case.ask: Vala okuthi {cap}? Umsizi {name} uvuleka futhi lapho ubukhona, futhi okwenziwe yikho kuyagcinwa.
case.allHint: Noma yini okufanele ilandwe isakubuza kuqala.
